name: Stone arch bridge
description: A single-arch fieldstone bridge about 5 m long and 2.2 m wide: a humpbacked gravel road rising from the ground at both ends over a segmental arch of dressed voussoirs, the spandrels and low parapets faced with rough fieldstones, the parapets capped with flat coping stones and squat end blocks.

provenance.prompt: bridge_stone_arch: a single-arch fieldstone bridge with low parapets, about 5 × 2.2 × 2 m, ends at ground level (plan 3, item 17).
